bio: Le Métro in the heart of Bracquegnies displays discreet references to the saxophone, which is Giuseppe’s favourite musical instrument. In the company of chef Rita, the couple invite you to sample authentic recipes and produce from Italy and Sicily in particular. Rita stuffs al dente tortelli with fresh, slightly salty ricotta, which is then served with a heavenly buttery sauce flavoured with mint and sage, before a twist of lemon and Timut pepper add the finishing touch to this heroically satisfying dish, that fully exemplifies Rita’s hallmark of wholesome fare. Food with feeling is the name of the game at Le Métro....
